newsitem.title: USA: Maine says Canadian firm wants to grow cranberries.
newsitem.headline: Maine says Canadian firm wants to grow cranberries.

text.p: Maine Agriculture Commissioner Ed McLaughlin said plans by a Canadian-owned company to develop 900 acres of new cranberry bogs could result in the largest cranberry farm in the country.
Cherryfield Foods, a blueberry processing firm, is seeking federal permits to develop the bogs on land it owns in Washington County.

Some environmentalists are opposed to the development because of the pesticides used in the cultivation of cranberries. If all the permits are granted, it will be at least three years before the bogs yield any berries.
